retrievalTexts: How does Minerva handle, manage, store, process, protect, or retain my personal data and chat messages? Privacy and data handling.
Who can see or read my Minerva conversations? Are my chats private from teachers, course staff, teaching assistants, or other students?
Where are my messages and course excerpts sent? Cerebras, OpenAI, local embeddings, external AI providers, and data sharing.
How long does Minerva keep my conversations and messages? Data retention, deletion, and removal.
What information do Canvas, Moodle, Play, Daisy, and LTI integrations send to or store in Minerva?
Hur hanterar, lagrar och skyddar Minerva mina personuppgifter och chattmeddelanden? Integritet, åtkomst, delning och lagringstid.
What AI model are you? Which LLM, which version? Are you ChatGPT, GPT-4, Gemini, Llama, or another vendor's chatbot?
How do you work? How do you find and use my course material to answer? Retrieval, embeddings, vector search, RAG.
Who built Minerva? Is it open source, where is the code and the technical documentation?
What can you see? Do you have access to the internet, to other courses, or to other students' conversations?
Vilken AI-modell är du och vem har byggt dig? Hur fungerar du och hur hittar du svaren i kursmaterialet?
